lines.text: This onion has a chemical weapon.
And today... it's aimed at Papa.
Pfft. Papa doesn't cry. Not even at weddings.
CHOP! The knife bursts the onion's tiny cells.
Two chemicals inside mix... and make a gas.
It floats up, stings his eyes, and they flood with tears to wash it out.
I'm NOT crying! The onion started it!
Tip: chill the onion first, and use a sharp knife. Less gas, fewer tears.
Good. Now cut five kilos... for the wedding.
